thread:
nisha: Heads up — draft private offer for OrionCloud SI co-sell. Need input on tranche sizes + renewal credit. TL;DR: 3 tranches, HW kicker, 12mo commit min. Ping @jorge @elaine
jorge: Love the approach. Can we make first tranche small to reduce friction? 50k?
elaine: Finance: 50k floor ok, but margin needs to be preserved. Propose discount matrix: 10% / 15% / 22% for 50k/250k/1M. Renewal credit = 10% of unused commit?
sam: Legal flag — check export controls on HW kicker + need a clean opt-out window in PO. Also prefer "on-invoice credit" wording over ambiguous "renewal credit".
kevin: From product: can we map tranche to Dedicated reserved-capacity tiers? e.g., Bronze -> 2x small pools, Silver -> 1 medium cluster, Gold -> dedicated rack. Also recommend token-based SKUs for public API pilots, reserved-capacity SKUs for Dedicated.
maria: Engineering notes: private deployment onboarding = 4w (VPC) + 3w (on-prem). Need Orion infra contact and SI runbook access.
nisha: Putting a quick sample offer below — please call out anything that would block signoff:
```
Offer: Orion Accelerator Private Offer
Tranches:
- Bronze: $50,000 commit -> 10% discount, 6% renewal credit (on-invoice), 6mo activation
- Silver: $250,000 commit -> 15% discount, 10% renewal credit (on-invoice), 9mo activation
- Gold: $1,000,000 commit -> 22% discount, 15% renewal credit (on-invoice), 12mo activation
HW kicker: up to $150k in appliance credits for co-sell (subject to export review)
SI enablement: $40k GTM fund on 12mo commit; $25k trial credits for top customers
Renewal cap: renewal credits capped at 30% of next-year invoice
Announce: joint PR + blog 2 weeks after kickoff; partner-listed SKU export in marketplace
```
elaine: Numbers look reasonable. Two asks: 1) change phrasing to "on-invoice credit" (agree), 2) cap renewal credits at 30% of next year usage (agree). Also need expected blended margin per tranche before final signoff.
jorge: Market ask: can we add a $25k trial bucket for top 10 prospects? That helps close POCs faster.
nisha: Agree to trial bucket. Action items: @sam legal to draft opt-out and export clauses by EOD Thu; @elaine finalize discount caps & margin calc; @maria share onboarding runbook + timeline; @kevin map tranches to Dedicated SKUs and reserved capacity definitions.
sam: On it — will draft language and ping for review.
kevin: I’ll produce a simple SKU mapping doc and drop it in the thread by tomorrow morning.
maria: :thumbsup: Need Orion infra contact to start runbook handoff — @jorge can you intro?
jorge: Intro sent (email) to infra-contact@orioncloud.com; they confirmed availability next week.
nisha: Thanks all. Planning to present this to OrionCloud on Mon 15:30 PT. Quick pre-brief Fri 10:00 PT? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the draft PO.
